Standard: Controls and displays provide the information and control functions needed to operate the fuel system for all phases of flight and operational conditions. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Conduct examination of design document to show interface requirements for the fuel system are defined and the information and controls needed to monitor and operate the fuel system are provided. Analysis.
  (1) Verify FMECA and SHA have determined which failures require flight crew action, and the corresponding failure information is correctly presented to the flight crew so that the correct actions can be taken. Test.
    (1) Lab test: Conduct lab testing to verify that the information and controls provided to the flight crew allow for operation of the fuel system under all operational conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
    (2) Flight test: Conduct flight testing to verify that the information and controls provided to the flight crew allow for operation of the fuel system under all operational conditions.
